This template is used to show a table of questions with answers in the print version of the [[Lojban by Choice]] wikibook. It is used like this:

<pre>{{SbcQuestionPrint
| <question1> | <answer1>
| <question2> | <answer2>
...
| <question20> | <answer20>
}}</pre>

While you can specify less than 20 question answer pairs, it is not possible to specify more than 20 pairs. This template is usually used together with [[Template:SbcQuestion]] for the normal version.
[[Category:Lojban by Choice/Templates|QuestionPrint]]</noinclude>
